job: Switch between views of the same object.
purpose: Underline tabs on a hairline; the accent underline slides between them. Buttons with role="tab" and aria-controls get the full pattern: arrow keys move and select, panels show and hide. Links with aria-current="page" are route tabs. A strip that overflows scrolls sideways, fades the clipped edge and keeps the selected tab in view. fd:change carries { value }.
useWhen: One object has several views: the output formats of a run, the sections of a record.
Each view is a panel on this page, or a route under the same object (route tabs).

avoidWhen.when: Options filter or toggle what is shown and there are two to five of them.
The items are categories to browse in a catalogue.
The links move between settings pages in a column.
The views are steps in a fixed order.
The sections are stacked and each opens in place.
